title: From Starting a Task to Finishing It Reliably
description: Five top stories and six briefs follow a listing filing, a cheaper computer-use model, code migration, GPU financing, and agents pitching newsrooms.

anthropic-ipo.verification_scope: Company filing announcement and TechCrunch's reading of the filing; circulating valuation targets are not treated as set terms

terra-launch.verification_scope: Official launch post; vendor evaluations under specified tests, not company-by-company savings

migration-trust.verification_scope: Engineering article; a method in progress, not a claim that migration is finished without review

spacex-lease.verification_scope: Apollo statement and TechCrunch report; financing commitment is not built compute

agents-journalists.verification_scope: Interviews; no evidence found that the agents sold a story to a newsroom

work-signals.verification_scope: Official data release; not a representative sample of all work and not a job-replacement rate

radio-cohost.verification_scope: Report on the program; listening growth is not a causal proof

misdirected-support.verification_scope: Publicly readable passage only; paywalled material not treated as reviewed

prompt-cache.verification_scope: Official caching guide; cache reuse is not long-term memory

agent-retrieval.verification_scope: Official example architecture; not a system deployed by this digest

ai-quest.verification_scope: Official education announcement; not students completing a real whole-brain map

meta-network.verification_scope: Public talks and slides; implementation not audited and the whole architecture not treated as fully open source

swe-shift.verification_scope: Abstract, method, results, and limitations; not peer reviewed or independently reproduced

agent-authorization.verification_scope: Published excerpts marked as automatic extracts; full recording not claimed as watched
